$comment: Known-violations allowlist for the axe baseline-ratchet gate (rule-id level). Each entry is deferred AA work with a milestone, not an accepted defect — the list only shrinks. The gate fails on any violation whose rule id is NOT here.

allow.reason: Measured against the wrong background, and it always will be: the editor paints no surface of its own, so this scan reports the harness shell's --color-bg (#2d3033, src/app.css) rather than the --color-surface (#1b1c21) the library declares. The dark accent reads 4.29:1 here and 5.50:1 on the surface it ships against. The library's own palette is certified without a browser by src/lib/test/invariants/lint/code-token-contrast.test.ts (G4.60).

Editable blocks (role=textbox: paragraphs, headings, code) have no accessible name. The per-block naming model is a consequence of the editor-root a11y-structure decision and is best settled against the integrated surface where focus/navigation semantics are real.

The thematic break uses a focusable role=separator, which axe treats as a slider-style separator requiring aria-valuenow/min/max. The focusable-separator semantics need rework (likely a different role or a non-focusable treatment).
